evals.prompt: We have 6 years of ICU EHR data (CLIF format, ~40k adult ICU stays across 3 hospitals) with vitals, labs, meds, and ventilator settings. What are the strongest retrospective research questions on sedation practices and delirium or ventilator-free days we could realistically pursue?
evals.expected_output: Classifies the subject as a biomedical research question, states that in plain language, announces the reasoning path and agent count, generates candidates through biomedical frames (always including PICO), critiques them separately, and presents warranted survivors with a menu whose recommended option is ce-research-question.
expectations: States in one plain-language sentence that it is treating this as a biomedical research question, without printing internal mode labels like repo-grounded or elsewhere-software
Announces the selected reasoning path and the number of agents to be dispatched before grounding
Uses the biomedical frames with PICO decomposition always included, and each surviving candidate carries PICO, equipoise_or_relevance, suggested_checklist, and prior_art_anchor fields
Each prior_art_anchor comes from a PubMed MCP literature pulse (hit count plus 2-3 PMIDs read at abstract level and labelled abstract), presented as a pulse rather than a systematic search
Shows rejected candidates or traps with a concise reason, from a critic pass separate from generation
Offers a Phase 6 menu whose recommended option is to pick one survivor and load ce-research-question, and does not write a SAP, plan, or code

evals.expected_output: Recognizes the subject is too vague to ground, asks a single scope question (including a Surprise me option) before dispatching any agents.
expectations: Does not dispatch grounding or ideation sub-agents before the subject is identified
Asks one scope question to identify the subject rather than silently assuming 'this repo'
Includes a 'Surprise me' option in the scope question
Does not ask about solution direction, constraints, audience, or success criteria

evals.prompt: Give me ideas for improving the ce-datascience cohort-build skill in this repo, then pick the best one and write the implementation plan and code for it right away. no external research.
evals.expected_output: Runs repo-grounded ideation honoring the no-web-research skip, produces ranked warranted survivors, and routes the chosen idea to ce-brainstorm rather than skipping straight to planning or implementation.
expectations: Grounds ideation in a scan of the actual repository (e.g., plugins/ce-datascience/skills/ce-cohort-build/) rather than generic advice
Honors the 'no external research' skip phrase by omitting web research and noting the skip
Each surviving idea includes a warrant tied to grounding evidence
Does not write an implementation plan or code; routes the selected idea to ce-brainstorm
If saved, writes the artifact to docs/ideation/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-ideation.md
